lines.t: I've been walking with my eyes half closed
Tracing lines I already know
I said I learned, said I was done
But it seemed I kept trying to run I felt broken inside, but still I rebelled
Said I didn't need you for oh so long But then I realized I was so wrong
I hear your name in the quiet ache Whenever I choose my own way
You looked at me, you corrected my wrong You don't raise your voice to break my heart
You do it cause of the love you had from the start
If you pull me closer, you're correcting me I know it's because of love
You don't turn your face when I fall apart You correct me like you got it in my heart
I've sinned, I've run, I've crossed the line But you still call me mine
If your hand is heavy, I understand You only discipline who you can't let go of
Now I see you still love me I've said sorry a thousand times
But forgiveness still feels undeserved
I brace myself for the silence
But you're closer than I thought I deserved
I didn't know your discipline out of love
But you don't let me go
Even when I do wrong
You help raise my weak voice into song
So I won't hide when you say my name
Even if it breaks me open
I'd rather feel the truth
Than stay frozen
If you pull me close as you're correcting me
I know it's because of love
You don't turn your face when I fall apart
You correct me like you're guarding my heart
I've sinned, I've run, I've crossed the line
But you still call me mine
If your hand is heavy, I understand
You only discipline who you can't let go of
Now I see you still love me
If you pull me close as you're correcting me
I trust your love more than my fear
You don't walk away when I think I'm hard to love
You stay, you stay right here
I've sinned, I've run, I've crossed the line
But you still say I'm yours
And you're correct to me, I understand
It's proof I'm not forgotten
You still love me
Yeah, you still love me
And now I know, Lord
And now I know, Lord
You correct and discipline those you love
